purpose: Plays the dialog page-advance 'fold-in' transition: collapses the two dialog-box corner sprites toward center over 4 frames while repainting the underlying scene, then settles the composed buffer to the framebuffer.
logic_summary: void __cdecl, __CHK(0x3c) stack-probe prologue. Seeds an on-stack 4-dword corner_state from dialog_advance_collapse_template[0..1] (sprite-index selectors 0x10/0x11) plus left offset -16 (0xFFFFFFF0) and right offset +16 (0x10); yes_no_box_addr = large_game_state_buffer + 0x1A59C. If battle_tile_map_ptr > 1, primes the battle base scene (palette tick + composite_battle_tile_map(buf+0x8088,0x1C8,0xD,8,origin_x,origin_y) + composite_all_chars_overlay). Then 4 frames: each frame advances corner_state[2]+=4 and corner_state[3]-=4 (both converge to 0 = center), copies 0x56 rows (stride: src 0x140 from ui_slide_composed_target_buf+0x8C05, dst 0x1C8 into large_game_state_buffer+0x8089+(row+0x6C)*0x1C8, 0x136 bytes/row), blits the two corner sprites at their current offsets via blit_sprite_with_stride_setup (selector=corner_state[i], offset=corner_state[i+2], looked up through menu_dialog_state_handle*0xC), then flushes the dialog band with blit_rectangle(0xA0504,0x140,buf+0x8088,0x1C8,0x138,0xC0). A final settle pass copies the bottom 0x56 rows of the composed buffer straight to the framebuffer at 0xA8C05. Body ends with shared-epilogue tail JMP 0x17E03 (mid-body of fd2_render_horizontal_bar_segments == return). src models the vendor's adjacent stack locals (template[0], template[1], leftoff, rightoff) as a single corner_state[4]; faithful and cleaner-equivalent to the decompilation.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects only: composites the page-advance fold-in animation into the work buffers and flushes the dialog band / settle rows to the framebuffer.
